documentedExamples.included: BW00-0(P-BAG) IS present with real structured data: it is the flowaccountModelCode ('factory_product_code' in ProductMaster.json) of canonical product PM-TMB (Thermal Tumbler SUS316), confirmed via factory_match_status=confirmed_supplier_mapping. PM-TMB is included in products.json and in the PKG-NY-2027-REACH-OPS bundle.
documentedExamples.note: TMS06-3(P-06) and TMS06-4(P-16) are documented in business-01-smart-gift docs/specs/TMS06-3-PRICING-CATALOG-INFOGRAPHIC-2026-09-10.md and TMS06-4-PRICING-CATALOG-INFOGRAPHIC-2026-09-10.md, and as raw offer codes in CatalogOffer.json source_projection (rowKey OFFER_TMS06-3 / OFFER_TMS06-4). They were NOT included as fixture bundle records: within the four permitted 02_prepared files, BundleOffer.json's bom array (the only structured, cost-stripped BOM source) has no rows for these offer codes, and CatalogOffer.json's price_rows/price_comparisons and the raw source_projection entries both carry empty source_price_tiers — so a bundle record for TMS06-3/TMS06-4 could not be built without inventing SRP or component data, which is disallowed.
